summary: Phase 39b Round 3 frontend testing completed - tested 5 document checklist flows (A, B, A2, A3, C2). FLOW A (upload→verify), FLOW B (reject with reason), FLOW A2 (re-upload after rejection), and FLOW C2 (customer checklist) all PASSED. FLOW A3 (duplicate file detection) FAILED - duplicate file content is accepted without error.

critical_bugs.issue: Duplicate file CONTENT detection not working - uploading the same file content multiple times is accepted without error. The unique index in doc_submissions only checks file_id uniqueness, but each upload creates a new file_id, so duplicate content is not detected.
critical_bugs.impact: Users can upload the same file multiple times, creating duplicate submissions. Main agent claimed this was fixed (500→400 with message), but testing shows it's not working.
critical_bugs.root_cause: The duplicate check in doc_registry.py line 159 uses unique index (org, entity_type, entity_id, requirement_code, file_id), but file_id is different for each upload. Should check file hash/content instead.
critical_bugs.expected_behavior: When uploading duplicate file content, should return 400 error with Indonesian message containing 'sudah pernah diserahkan'
critical_bugs.actual_behavior: Both /files/upload and /doc/submissions return 200 OK, file is accepted

medium_priority: Fix duplicate file CONTENT detection in doc_registry.py: Currently only checks file_id uniqueness, but each upload creates new file_id.
